sqlite_structural_gap_note:
## Receipt eligibility after archive repair: remaining SQLite gaps

The [fresh source-pinned evidence](evidence/tofudb_receipt_proof_retry_20261005.json)
retains all paired native legs and a separate 16-phase resource-observed small
matrix on local xfs: Strict embedded TofuDB, SQLite Sidecar and raw SQLite.
Every phase completes, with no skipped engine. In comparable application scopes,
native latency is lower than Sidecar in this matrix; this single cohort does not
certify all workloads. Recovery scopes differ (embedded abandon, process-kill
Sidecar, graceful raw control), so their latency ratios cannot establish a win.
Search preparation is reported separately from timed queries; neither preparation
nor process-kill coverage is replaced by an unqualified speedup ratio.

The native/raw P50 gaps above 2x remain explicit debt: conversation create 3.4x,
record point read 4.0x, mixed 80/10/10 4.0x, search 6.2x, windowed history 9.0x,
sidebar with history 2.4x, swarm writes 5.8x, transcript hydration 9.9x and escaped
large append 3.0x. Raw point/create/mixed/swarm paths bypass the v4 SDK, typed
semantic compilation, owner/repository checks, command receipts and logical
event publication. Native history/search paths additionally resolve versioned
documents and verified Blob/projection data; the floor uses direct SQL/indexed
rows. These boundaries name structural work, not a license to leave it unoptimized
or proof that all of the measured ratio is attributable to any one boundary.
The separate native observer identifies about 1.58ms per random large response
in receipt compression; escaped policy parsing was removed. Point-read and history
gaps still require stage attribution with equivalent semantics and owned identity.

Post-run logical file sizes are native 205,231,333, Sidecar 769,651,752 and raw
554,197,264 bytes across all phases. Process write-byte observations are retained
but exclude later work and are not a physical write-amplification certificate;
file size does not establish allocated/resident bytes. Resource observation and
different process/transport boundaries are disclosed. Fixed-arrival, active
streaming, FUSE, distracted hosts and 1,000 active attempts remain uncovered here.
